newsitem.title: USA: Disc offers to swap warrants for stock.
newsitem.headline: Disc offers to swap warrants for stock.

text.p: Disc Graphics Inc said Friday warrant holders could exchange 8.5 Disc warrants for one of the company's common shares.
Disc stock closed at 3-1/2 Thursday, while its warrants closed at 5/8. The proposed exchange ratio of 8.5:1 would have warrant holders surrender 5-5/16 in value for the 3-1/2 stock.

"When the company first proposed it, the warrants were trading at a quarter or so," a spokesman explained, adding the offer "can be adjusted" to reflect the current relationship between the stock and warrant.
The company said holders can exchange 8.5 class A redeemable common stock purchase warrants for one share of Disc common stock until August 22 1600 EDT/2000 GMT.
The manufacturer and printer of specialty packaging reported a $504,000 net, or $0.09 a share, in the first quarter, compared with a flat quarter the year before.
